name: css-lsp
description: CSS language server (vscode-css-language-server, from the npm package vscode-langservers-extracted) for code intelligence in .css, .scss and .less files - diagnostics, hover, definitions, references, symbols and formatting. Registers an LSP server only: no hooks, commands, agents or skills. Needs Node.js and a global 'vscode-langservers-extracted' install; the plugin does not install either.
